profile.name: Law
profile.overview: Law is a close range, poking-based, slide archetype character with strong neutral tools and strong block punishment. A legacy character with traditionally challenging execution, he is very accessible this time around and is suitable for anyone looking to live out their Bruce Lee fantasy.
profile.playstyle: Close-range poking with a slide and strong punishment. Win neutral with quick pokes and some of the fastest panic moves in the game, punish hard standing and crouching, and use Dragon Sign Stance (DSS) for follow-ups. His backdash is slow, so fight up close rather than running.
strengths: Lightning-quick: Some of the fastest panic moves in the game, including d+2,3 and 1,1,1.
Slide to the Left: One of the better crouch mixups in the game.

Fiery Action: Heat engagers include a i10 CH string, a i14 CH string, and a low crush. Nunchuck moves become more rewarding on hit and safer on block, and Law's Heat Smash is one of the fastest in the game.
weaknesses: Baby Steps: One of the few characters with a slower backdash.
Quick Burner: Combos become more complicated during heat if heat consumption is a concern.
Up Close and Personal: Only strong at a close range.

stances.name: Dragon Sign Stance
stances.entry: F after 1,1,2 and 4,3; ws3 transitions too
stances.note: DSS.3 is a homing high, +3 on block; DSS.f+1 is a Heat Engager. In Heat, DSS automatically parries punches (Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: i10 punish string, -6 on block, can enter DSS with F.
Body Blow > Dragon Lift: fast panic string that tornadoes on counter hit, -15 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: One of his fastest panic options (Wavu).
keyMoves.use: When you are pressured and expect a button.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Panic button with a big reward.

keyMoves.summary: Dragon Hammer: i20 mid, +3c on block, launches on counter hit.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus mid with a CH launch.

keyMoves.summary: Dragon Raise: i15 launcher, -7 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i15 launch punisher, safe on block.
keyMoves.avoid: Against crouchers: only +4s on normal hit.

keyMoves.summary: Dragon's Rising Kick: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
i16 nunchaku mid, tornadoes on counter hit.
Dragon Uppercut: i15 while-standing launcher, -18 on block.
Shin Crusher: i17 low, -13 on block, +13g on counter hit.
Banana Peel: i18 slide low, -15 on block.
Dragon's Fury: i18 mid Heat Engager, -8 on block.
Running Side Kick: i20 mid from a run, +6 on block.
keyMoves.use: To close distance and keep the turn.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side swap.

combos.name: Launch BnB: 4,u+3 b+2 b+2,1 T! 4,3~F DSS.f+4
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as df+2 or uf+4.
mistakes: Holding F too late after 4,3: DSS has to start straight away.
